param: B Influx rate of the susceptible human population.
μₕ The natural death rate of the human hosts.
βₕ The age-specific transmission rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible hosts.
k Age-dependent rate at which exposed individuals become infectious.
ρ The probability of exposed hosts transferring to symptomatic infectious hosts.
γ₁ The age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious hosts.
γ₂ The age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious hosts.
σ The factor characterizing the intensity of reinfection of asymptomatic infectious hosts.
μᵥ The natural death rate of the mosquitoes.
βᵥ The age-specific transmission rate from infectious hosts to susceptible mosquitoes.
Bᵥ Recruitment rate of susceptible mosquitoes (assumed to balance deaths to maintain a constant total population).
prog_rate_symp Rate of progression from Exposed to Symptomatic Infectious.
prog_rate_asymp Rate of progression from Exposed to Asymptomatic Infectious.
reinfection_rate Effective contact rate for reinfection of asymptomatic individuals.
